decision_basis: declared after all development results (V2, V3 basic, ensembles, CNN, transfer) and before any locked-test prediction; the test is run once

single_class_people.18: vehicle only: observed-class recall only, excluded from two-class metrics

selection: 3-fold grouped CV on all development people (compare.inner_partitions over the 23 people, seed 42), with each method's own declared grid and rule; refit on all 961 development windows

deep.details: scratch CNN tuned with early stopping on the three development partitions, refit for the median best epoch; transfer pretrained per partition on that partition's training people, final pretraining on all development people's instruction/answer windows; seed 42 primary, 43-44 spread

primary_metric: mean two-class balanced accuracy with equal weight per locked-test participant (6 eligible people)
uncertainty: percentile 95% intervals from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of the eligible test people (seed 42), for each method and for the paired A-minus-B difference within each family; descriptive only with six people
timing: full-development refit wall time; prediction of the locked-test windows in 5 warm batches (single thread for the CNN, as in development)
guard: final_test.py refuses to run if results/final_test/ exists; no rerun after inspecting results
interpretation_rule: development (outer-fold) and test results are reported side by side; no model is re-chosen on test scores
